role.title: Senior Functional Consultant
role.role_basis: O*NET 15-1211.00 Computer Systems Analysts / ESCO 'ICT application configurator' occupation (senior functional-consultant profile)
role.context_note: Currently a Functional Consultant Level 3 (software consultancy, 4-7 yrs; software/product knowledge, configuration troubleshooting, workshop facilitation, mentoring junior consultants); growing into cross-functional expertise, solution design leadership, trusted advisory, solution evaluation -- a level 3-to-4 progression within the same track. role_title cleaned from their literal Q9 answer "Functional Consultant Level 4" (an internal grade, not an external job-ad title) into a standard seniority label.

courses.title: Cross-Functional Expertise for Senior Consultants
courses.description: Cross-Functional Expertise for Senior Consultants focuses on cross-functional expertise for people working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces software product knowledge, enough to apply alongside cross-functional expertise in real Senior Functional Consultant work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to cross-functional expertise and show how software product knowledge supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying cross-functional expertise to a real Senior Functional Consultant scenario
Practicing cross-functional expertise through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to software product knowledge
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Solution Evaluation in Practice
courses.description: Solution Evaluation in Practice goes beyond the basics of solution evaluation, for people already working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in solution evaluation and want to go further.

alternates.title: Cross-Functional Expertise Essentials
alternates.description: Cross-Functional Expertise Essentials is a short introduction to cross-functional expertise for people moving toward a Senior Functional Consultant role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show cross-functional expertise in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if cross-functional expertise is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying cross-functional expertise to a real Senior Functional Consultant scenario
Practicing cross-functional expertise through guided exercises
Building a short cross-functional expertise exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Cross-Functional Expertise Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Cross-Functional Expertise Techniques is a focused course on cross-functional expertise for people already working toward a Senior Functional Consultant role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying cross-functional expertise on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying cross-functional expertise to a real Senior Functional Consultant scenario
Practicing cross-functional expertise through guided exercises
Building a short cross-functional expertise exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
